text.text:
I don't think ImpV took WieenN to make her play like zAAz. She is not her, neither are Hanka and Angelka. The respective positions of the two players are different. On Ancient for example, WieenN plays on Donut, rotating between A and Mid, while zAAz tended to play between B and the cat room through the Cave. Of course, their game plan differs depending on the team they are facing and the validity of the game plan at the moment, but even though WieenN might take over some zAAz's positions (I didn't try to make a 1v1 comparison, I leave that to professional analysts ^^'), they cannot play like they did before.

My guess is that ImpV needed fresh and younger blood, with correct recent results and maybe some cultural proximity. Yes, Hanka and Angelka are young, but was Hanka interested in playing for Imperial? Would Angelka get an offer given her stats last season? By the way, they got WiennN for free.

text.text:
I am glad I had a good night and good rest, because I wanted to break everything yesterday. Now, we need to talk.

Honestly, when I saw the veto, I was like "Why didn't they ban Inferno?", even though maybe they had not a lot of choices, because Overpass could have been picked. Then, after 7-8 rounds on Inferno, I was like "It's over, they're gonna get crushed 2-0", and then I stopped watching when BIG took the first map. 

I watched the other match between 888aura and Let Her Cook... Well, at least it was competitive on Dust2 so I will not complain about that. I still had the other stream on the second screen, so I took a look on the scoreboard. When I saw 12-4, I was disgusted.

I am still glad that aNa showed a good performance on Inferno and during her last match against Peekaboo, despite the drama that happened in her life. Yet, I don't understand how this loss happened. At worst, I expected a 1-2 loss if that happens,, but this...

Is it because the roster became predictable in their game plan? Is it because of the confidence (again)?
Is is because their game plan was not followed? Miscommunication? All of those?
I know
